Name: Ridgeside Village Happy Birthday Content Pack (English)
Author: xiaoleiwen
Description:
This Mod is an English content pack for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/520]Happy Birthday[/url] Mod that has added birthday gift dialogues and mails for the npc of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url] Mod.

[b][u]Notes:[/u][/b]
[list=1]
[*]This Mod is translated from the original mod written in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16040]Chinese language[/url].
[*]I rearranged and re-coded the lines and portraits, so that they look more consistent with the English game, and hopefully more immersive.
[*]I also converted it into a content pack Mod for Happy Birthday, so it can be installed independently, without the need of replacing files from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11148]Happy Birthday English Content Pack[/url] such as the original mod in Chinese.
[/list]
[b][u]Installation:
[/u][/b][list=1]
[*]Make sure you have SMAPI downloaded.
[*]Make sure you have the main Mod, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/520]Happy Birthday[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url] downloaded.
[*]Download this mod and extract it's contents into StardewValley/Mods folder
[/list] ﻿Which should look like StardewValley/Mods/HappyBirthdayContentPack RSV-English
